explanation: This slide outlines the classification categories of invertebrate diversity: Simple Invertebrates, Radiata, Protostomia (further divided into Lophotrochozoa and Ecdysozoa), and Deuterostomia.

questions.q: Which of the following sub-groups is classified under Protostomia?
questions.exp: Under the heading 'Protostomia', the outline lists 'Lophotrochozoa' and 'Ecdysozoa'.
